## App structure overview

This is a **single-page Next.js 16 App Router app**. There are **no separate routes** for homepage vs playground — both are stages inside one client component.

```
app/
  layout.tsx          Root layout, fonts, metadata
  page.tsx            Only route: renders <ForestDemo />
  globals.css         Design tokens + page background

components/
  forest/             Demo UI + viz
  walkthrough/        Tour modal
  ui/                 Shared primitives

lib/forest/           Algorithm, dataset, stage copy, types
```

---

## 1. Pages, routes, components

### Routing
| Path | File | What it renders |
|------|------|-----------------|
| `/` only | `/home/kiyaanpillai/Documents/jclinic/bootcamp-27/tree-visualizer/app/page.tsx` | `<ForestDemo />` |

```1:5:app/page.tsx
import { ForestDemo } from "@/components/forest/ForestDemo";

export default function Home() {
  return <ForestDemo />;
}
```

No `app/playground`, no `Link`/`useRouter` navigation. Stage changes are React state (`DemoStage`).

### Relevant file map

| Role | Absolute path |
|------|----------------|
| Homepage entry | `/home/kiyaanpillai/Documents/jclinic/bootcamp-27/tree-visualizer/app/page.tsx` |
| Root layout | `.../app/layout.tsx` |
| Global styles | `.../app/globals.css` |
| **Orchestrator** | `.../components/forest/ForestDemo.tsx` (+ `.module.css`) |
| Stage copy / order | `.../lib/forest/stages.ts` |
| Types / stages enum | `.../lib/forest/types.ts` |
| Tour modal | `.../components/walkthrough/WalkthroughPortal.tsx` (+ `.module.css`) |
| Stage sidebar | `.../components/forest/StageSidebar.tsx` (+ `.module.css`) |
| Scatter plot | `.../components/forest/ScatterPlot.tsx` |
| Tree viz | `.../components/forest/TreeView.tsx` |
| Vote merge viz | `.../components/forest/EnsembleMerge.tsx` |
| Header | `.../components/ui/Header.tsx` |
| Button / Slider / Tooltip / Stack | `.../components/ui/{Button,Slider,Tooltip,Stack}.tsx` |
| Forest math | `.../lib/forest/{forest,tree,dataset,layout}.ts` |

---

## 2. Homepage vs playground (what loads, what CTAs do)

### On load
1. `stage` starts as `"welcome"`; tour starts open (`tourOpen: true`, `tourStep: 0`).
2. User sees:
   - Blurred **WalkthroughPortal** overlay (3-step modal)
   - Behind it: **Header** (“Forest Lab”) + **welcome hero** + **StageSidebar**

```35:38:components/forest/ForestDemo.tsx
export function ForestDemo() {
  const [tourOpen, setTourOpen] = useState(true);
  const [tourStep, setTourStep] = useState(0);
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<DemoStage>("welcome");
```

### Welcome hero (homepage)
Shown only when `stage === "welcome"`:

```370:402:components/forest/ForestDemo.tsx
          {stage === "welcome" ? (
            <section className={styles.hero}>
              <div className={styles.heroCopy}>
                <p className={styles.heroEyebrow}>Machine learning · ensembles</p>
                <h1 className={styles.heroTitle}>Random Forest, demystified</h1>
                ...
                <Cluster gap="sm">
                  <Button variant="accent" size="lg" onClick={() => goStage("data")}>
                    Start with the data
                  </Button>
                  <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => goStage("explore")}>
                    Jump to playground
                  </Button>
                </Cluster>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.heroVisual}>
                ... mini TreeView previews ...
```

### “Jump to playground”
- Calls `goStage("explore")` → sets `stage` to `"explore"`.
- Hides hero; shows **workspace** (scatter + tree + votes + **Forest knobs**).
- Sidebar eyebrow becomes `"Playground"` (`lib/forest/stages.ts`).

### “Start with the data”
- Calls `goStage("data")`.
- Enters guided stage 1: scatter plot of the leaf dataset; sidebar narrates “Three kinds of leaves”.
- Does **not** close the tour overlay by itself — user must Skip / finish the portal first (or it stays on top until dismissed).

---

## 3. Major flows (stage machine)

Stages in order (`STAGE_ORDER` from `lib/forest/stages.ts`):

| # | `DemoStage` | UI shown | Behavior |
|---|-------------|---------|----------|
| 1 | `welcome` | Hero + mini trees | Intro CTAs |
| 2 | `data` | ScatterPlot (selectable) | Meet dataset |
| 3 | `bootstrap` | Scatter (bag highlight / OOB dim) + TreeView | Per-tree bootstrap bag |
| 4 | `grow` | TreeView node reveal animation | Auto-grow; “Replay growth” |
| 5 | `predict` | Scatter + TreeView path animation | “Walk through trees” |
| 6 | `vote` | Scatter + EnsembleMerge | “Merge votes” |
| 7 | `explore` | All panels + knobs | Playground / rebuild |

Navigation controls:
- Header **Back** / **Next step** → `prevStage` / `nextStage`
- Sidebar **Jump to** numbered buttons `1…7` → `onJump(id)` / `goStage`
- Header **Replay tour** → resets tour to step 0 and reopens portal

---

## 4. Current tour / walkthrough / onboarding

### What exists
**Only** `WalkthroughPortal` — a centered modal overlay, **not** a spotlight / element-anchored product tour.

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| File | `components/walkthrough/WalkthroughPortal.tsx` |
| Steps | Hardcoded `STEPS` array (3 steps) |
| UI | `role="dialog"` overlay; dots; Skip / Next / “Enter the forest” |
| State | Owned by `ForestDemo` (`tourOpen`, `tourStep`) |
| Finish | On last step Next → `setTourOpen(false)`; Skip same |
| Replay | Header “Replay tour” |

Tour copy:


```335:343:components/forest/ForestDemo.tsx
      <WalkthroughPortal
        open={tourOpen}
        step={tourStep}
        onSkip={() => setTourOpen(false)}
        onNext={() => {
          if (tourStep >= 2) setTourOpen(false);
          else setTourStep((s) => s + 1);
        }}
      />
```

### What does **not** exist
- No `data-tour`, `data-testid`, or tour-target attributes
- No highlight rings / coach marks attached to specific UI
- No library (Driver.js, Shepherd, Intro.js, etc.)
- Stage progression is separate from the modal tour (sidebar + Next step)

Secondary onboarding: **StageSidebar** educational copy + live notes + **HelpHint** (`?`) tooltips on knobs / focus tree.

## 5. Key playground UI targets (for a guided tour)

**Important:** CSS Modules hash class names; there are almost **no stable DOM selectors**. Best current hooks: button text, `aria-*`, or you’d need to add `data-*` attributes.

| Tour target | Component | How to find today | CSS module class (source) |
|-------------|-----------|-------------------|---------------------------|
| Brand / chrome | `Header` | text “Forest Lab” | `styles.header`, `styles.brand` |
| Replay tour | Button in Header | text “Replay tour” | — |
| Back / Next step | Header actions | text “Back”, “Next step” | — |
| Hero CTA: data | welcome only | “Start with the data” | `styles.hero` |
| Hero CTA: playground | welcome only | “Jump to playground” | — |
| Stage narrative | `StageSidebar` | `aria-label="What’s happening"` | `styles.sidebar` |
| Jump pad | sidebar buttons | “Jump to” + numbered 1–7 | `styles.nav` |
| Live notes | sidebar | “Right now” section | `styles.live` |
| Focus tree picker | toolbar | “Focus tree” + numbered tree buttons | `styles.toolbar`, `styles.toolLabel` |
| Walk through trees | toolbar | button text | — |
| Merge votes | toolbar | button text | — |
| Replay growth | grow stage | button text | — |
| Scatter / data | `ScatterPlot` | title “Leaf feature space” / bag title | `ScatterPlot.module.css` `.root` |
| Decision tree | `TreeView` | title `Tree N` | `TreeView.module.css` `.root` |
| Vote viz | `EnsembleMerge` | “Tree votes → forest decision” / “Forest ballot” | `EnsembleMerge.module.css` |
| Forest knobs | explore only | “Forest knobs” | `styles.controls` |
| n_trees / depth / ratio | `Slider` ×3 | labels | `Slider.module.css` `.root` |
| Rebuild forest | Button | “Rebuild forest” | — |
| Tour portal itself | `WalkthroughPortal` | `role="dialog"` `aria-modal="true"` | `.overlay`, `.portal` |

## 6. Design system / styling patterns

| Pattern | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| Styling | **CSS Modules** per component + **Tailwind v4** imported in `globals.css` (mostly tokens/utilities; UI is module-driven) |
| Tokens | CSS vars in `:root`: moss/canopy greens, sun amber, sky blue, paper/ink |
| Fonts | **Fraunces** (display), **Nunito** (body), **Geist Mono** — via `next/font` in `layout.tsx` |
| Look | Soft forest/lab: multi-layer green radial gradients + subtle grid overlay on `body` |
| Components | Local primitives: `Button` (primary/secondary/ghost/accent × sm/md/lg), `Slider`, `Tooltip`/`HelpHint`, `Stack`/`Cluster`, `Header` |
| Motion | CSS keyframes (`floatIn`, portal `rise`/`fadeIn`); JS intervals for grow/predict/vote animations |
| Color semantics | `CLASS_COLORS`: oak `#2d6a4f`, maple `#d97706`, pine `#0284c7` |
| Layout shell | `styles.app` → Header
